title: A Cargo Ship Rammed the Mir Space Station and Punched a Hole in It

scenes.text: A cargo ship rammed a space station and punctured it.
June 1997, Russia's Mir. A supply ship was being flown by hand in a docking test.
It hit the Spektr module, damaged a solar panel, and punched a hole in the hull.
Air leaked out. The crew pulled cables from the hatchway and sealed the module off.
The crash also set Mir spinning, once every six minutes. They got it under control.
A hand-flown test, a hole in a space station, and a sealed door.

description:
A Progress cargo ship rammed Russia's Mir space station in 1997 and punctured the Spektr module.
The crew sealed the hatch to stop Mir from depressurizing, and the collision set the station spinning about once every six minutes.
Could you stay calm if this happened to your home in orbit? Comment below.
thumbnail_text: CARGO SHIP RAMMED A SPACE STATION
first_comment: The crew sealed Spektr and kept living on Mir. If a hatch in your home had to stay shut forever, which room would you give up?
